limitations: Manually chosen candidates are not uniquely identified by the user; exact surveyed line/width remains uncertain.
Sampling buffers are approximate: 40 m tolerance is not measured registration error.
Two optical local integer-shift checks found zero best shift; SAR/subpixel registration remains unverified.
Reference optical variability comes from a selected eight-date sample; some pixels have fewer than five clear dates.
Persistence covers two 500 m windows on 7, 20 and 30 June only, not full corridors/monthly confirmation.
Independent imagery is WMS-derived with conflicting date metadata; no verified before/after interval.
13 current original-run artifacts mismatch archived output hashes; unchanged during review and current hashes pinned.
No held-out road labels: all threshold results are screening stability, not accuracy.
BFAST, CCDC, probabilistic fusion, NDMI/NBR and causal/legal attribution not executed; appropriate data or labels absent.
Interactive browser rendering unavailable; maps/figures inspected through image tools and links checked.
